# Life Hacks Germany
> Verification-first practical guides for expats and locals living in Germany.
> Languages: English (EN) at /en, German (DE) at /de
> Contact: golifehacks@gmx.de
> Updated: 2026-04-07

## About
Life Hacks Germany publishes verified guides covering German bureaucracy, taxes, housing, mobility, and everyday life. All guides cite primary German law and official government sources.
